title: BioSentinel at EXIST 2026: Soft-Label Optimization with XLM-RoBERTa for Sexism Intent Classification in Memes

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying the communicative intent of meme OCR text into non-sexist, direct sexist, or judgemental (implicit) sexist categories using a soft-label optimization approach with XLM-RoBERTa to account for annotator disagreement.
